repo_path.description: Absolute path to the local tldr pages repository.

platform.description: The operating system platform (linux, osx, or sunos).

locale.description: The locale code for looking up pages (e.g., en, zh).

config_path.description: The directory where the tldr-py configuration file resides.

verbose.description: Whether to enable verbose logging output.

repositories.description: List of git repository URLs to fetch tldr pages from.
